libs.note: BH-4988 r2 (BH-4975.3). Sibling sequencing at plan time. When bin/plan-overlap.sh says build, bin/lib/rb/gates.sh asks bin/plan-sibling.sh check: for a child ticket (`Part of #P`) on a GitHub-Issues board it reads the open sibling issues, their open PRs (ticket/<prefix>-<n>[-rN] or agent/<PREFIX>-<n>, minus the stack base) and those PRs' changed files, and answers plan-overlap's own `OVERLAP_DEFER <KEY> vs <SIB> files=[..]` on a non-fragment intersection, so the existing After: hold applies until that PR merges or closes. Every After: decision on a child is then posted once on the child issue by plan-sibling.sh note (comment-mark key `sequenced <project> <KEY>:<OTHER>`). Every choice is a PLAN_SIBLING line in the build's pipeline.log and logs/plan-hotspot.log. Fragment dirs come from lib.plan-hotspot. The script calls lib_env_apply plan-sibling <project>.

knobs.note: 1 = check siblings' open PRs at plan time; 0 = off (check exits 0 before any read). Read as a settings row, then env, then env/global.env, then 1.
1 = post the one sequencing note on a held child issue; 0 = log `comment=off` and post nothing. Read as a settings row, then env, then env/global.env, then 1.
Cap on the open-issue read that finds siblings. A read that reaches it logs incomplete=1 and judges what it read. Below 100 is raised to 100.
Cap on sibling PRs whose changed files are read per plan. Past it the rest are not judged and the decision logs incomplete=1.
